keywords.def: A whole number or the negative of a whole number.
Two numbers at the same distance from 0 on different sides.

en.text: Integers are the whole numbers and their negatives. Right on the number line is bigger. To add, use the sign of the bigger magnitude. To subtract, add the opposite. Same signs multiply or divide to a positive; different signs to a negative.

screens.title: Warm up: what is the sign?
items: Two negatives add to a negative.

screens.title: Summary for unit two

screens.title: Key words of the unit
defs: A whole number or the negative of a whole number.

screens.text: Mixed operations: match each calculation with its answer.

screens.why:
Two at a time.
Step 1: −90 + (−489): both negative. 90 + 489 = 579. So −579.
Step 2: −579 + 315: 579 > 315 and 579 is negative, so the sum is negative.
Step 3: 579 − 315 = 264. Answer −264.

Count the negatives: −4, −25, −1. That is 3, odd. So the product is negative.
Multiply the sizes: 4 × 25 = 100.
100 × 14 = 1400. 1400 × 1 = 1400.
Answer: −1400.

screens.ask: Integers in a game: Abel lost 30 points in round one and gained 13 in round two. His net score is ___
screens.why:
A loss is negative: −30. A gain is positive: +13.
Net score = −30 + 13.
Different signs: 30 > 13 and 30 is negative, so the answer is negative.
30 − 13 = 17. Net score: −17.
screens.clue: Loss is negative, gain is positive.

screens.title: Two rules
steps: Different signs: take the sign of the bigger size, then subtract the sizes.
Two negatives: add the sizes and keep −. −15 + (−35) = −50.

screens.why:
Different signs.
The bigger magnitude is 9, and it is negative: the sum is negative.
9 − 4 = 5.
So −9 + 4 = −5.
screens.clue: Which number has the bigger size?

screens.title: Sign of a product
steps: Same signs: the product is positive. −3 × (−5) = 15.
Different signs: the product is negative. −3 × 5 = −15.
Multiply the sizes, then put the sign in front.

screens.why:
Different signs, so the product is negative.
4 × 6 = 24.
So −4 × 6 = −24.

items.text: Sets of numbers: show the relation between ℕ, 𝕎 and ℤ.
items.why:
Every natural number is whole: ℕ ⊂ 𝕎.
Every whole number is an integer: 𝕎 ⊂ ℤ.
So ℕ ⊂ 𝕎 ⊂ ℤ.
𝕎 ⊂ ℕ is wrong: 0 is whole but not natural.

items.ask: Opposite numbers: the opposite of −1020 is ___
items.why:
−1020 is 1020 steps left of 0.
Its opposite is the same distance on the other side.
So the opposite is 1020.

items.text: Integers between two numbers: list all integers between −12 and −10.
items.why:
Count from −12 to −10: −12, −11, −10.
Leave out the two ends.
Only −11 is left.

items.text: Compare integers: which sign is correct? −34 ? −304
items.why:
Both numbers are negative.
−34 is 34 steps from 0; −304 is 304 steps.
−34 is closer to 0, so it is further right and greater.
So −34 > −304.

Different signs.
The bigger magnitude is 545, and it is negative: the sum is negative.
545 − 511 = 34.
So −545 + 511 = −34.

Subtracting −412 means adding 412: −1099 + 412.
Different signs: 1099 > 412 and 1099 is negative, so the answer is negative.
1099 − 412 = 687.
Answer: −687.

Count the negative factors: there are six −1s.
6 is even, so the product is positive.
All sizes are 1, and 1 × 1 × … × 1 = 1.
Answer: 1.

items.text: Properties of multiplication: name the property m × (n + p) = (m × n) + (m × p)
items.why:
The factor m is shared out over the bracket (n + p).
That has the shape a × (b + c) = (a × b) + (a × c).
So it is the distributive property.

items.ask: Divide integers (the answer can be a decimal): −54 ÷ 4 = ___
items.why:
Different signs, so the quotient is negative.
54 ÷ 4 = 13 remainder 2.
2 ÷ 4 = 0.5, so 54 ÷ 4 = 13.5.
Answer: −13.5.

items.text: Even and odd results: the difference of any two odd integers is
items.why:
Try an example: 7 − 5 = 2, even.
Another: 9 − 3 = 6, even.
The two leftover 1s cancel out.
So odd − odd is always even.
